answer: The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, published publicly on failure. A vault of per-task receipts records who did what, and the orchard of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The forge of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
